name: ESP C130 Raptor (ESP Raptor, 130 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC w/o tip, printed ".130". Without the tip installed, determined at 50 yards (page footnote). No method mark: method not stated. The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G1 BC w/tip, printed ".305 (O89)". With the tip installed, determined at 250 yards (page footnote). Marked (O89): Oehler 89 system. The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 8, Enhanced System Projectile (ESP): Caliber .308, Grains 130, Minimum Required Twist 1-11", Part Number ESP C130 Raptor, G1 BC w/o tip .130, G1 BC w/tip .305 (O89), OAL w/o tip 1.037", OAL w/tip 1.415", Bullet Projection w/o tip .380", Bullet Projection w/tip .758", Blunt Trauma Base™ ~ Retained Weight (grains) 92

note: Also printed: OAL w/o tip 1.037" (the length stored is with the tip). Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: w/o tip .380"; w/tip .758".
